preconditions.description: The input root is a TreeNode and K is an integer.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of each node is between -10^5 and 10^5.
The value of K is between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of paths is non-negative.
The output is the number of paths in the tree that sum to K.
